reason: The clearing sky makes the dusty array useful again, so I want to restore its output first.
expectation: The soft brush should remove settled dust and improve solar power; I don't know whether this alone restarts services.

alternatives.reason: Restoring the water line also seems necessary, but power seems like a good first step.

effect: The solar supply is restored, so I can reconnect the cold case to it.
reaction: A straightforward, satisfying first repair, though the result is terse.
reason: The discovery case needs continuous refrigeration, so switching it to restored power seems useful.
expectation: The case will run on solar supply instead of backup while staying cold.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs restarting, but the frozen discovery feels more urgent.

effect: The case is now on station power, leaving the water line as the next obvious service to restore.
reaction: Reassuring to put the important sample back on normal power.
reason: The previously drained line needs water to return the supply to service.
expectation: The line will be refilled after its thaw checks, restoring the water connection.

alternatives.reason: I could water the potatoes now, but restarting the main line seems more fundamental.

effect: The tap works again and the focus has shifted to moving both troughs back into daylight.
reaction: The pump pushing air out gives a satisfying physical detail to the restart.
reason: I will place the lettuce at the shelf to begin the new goal.
expectation: The lettuce trough moves to the window; the potatoes will still need moving too.

alternatives.reason: Either trough could go first; I picked the lettuce without a strong preference.

effect: The lettuce is at the shelf; I still need to move the potatoes.
reaction: A simple placement with no particular surprise.
reason: The stated goal calls for both troughs at the window.
expectation: The potato trough will join the lettuce at the shelf and may complete the goal.

alternatives.reason: Watering the potatoes seems useful too, but I want to complete the move first.

effect: Both troughs are back at the window and the chapter is complete without needing the offered watering actions.
reaction: A quiet, pleasant ending, though the placement itself is very plain.

mostWorthwhile.text: Priming the exterior line gave a concrete picture of air being pushed out and water reaching the tap again. It made the return to normal feel tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two trough placements were repetitive and had little feedback beyond confirming their location.

surprise.text: I was mildly surprised that moving both troughs finished the chapter while watering remained available.

arbitrary.text: No action I chose felt purposeless: the repairs and placements followed the goals. The order of the two troughs had no clear significance.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue for the fate of the discovery and the return journey; this chapter's quiet recovery is appealing, though its individual decisions were mostly obvious.
